create or replace function private.weekly_source_kept_as_paid_facts_v1(p_work_event_id uuid,p_reason text)

set search_path to 'pg_catalog','pg_temp'
as $function$
declare
  v_event public.weekly_work_events%rowtype;
  v_publication public.weekly_source_projection_publications%rowtype;
  v_upload public.weekly_source_uploads%rowtype;
  v_roots uuid[]; v_root uuid; v_revision uuid; v_segments jsonb; v_segment jsonb;
  v_movements uuid[]:='{}'::uuid[]; v_movement uuid; v_present boolean; v_credits uuid[];
begin
  if p_work_event_id is null or p_reason is null or p_reason not in ('CREDITED','NOT_INVOICED_DISAPPEARED') then
    raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_KEEP_AS_PAID_REASON_INVALID' using errcode='22023'; end if;
  select * into strict v_event from public.weekly_work_events where id=p_work_event_id;
  -- Latest actual export publication covering this date. A report is never
  -- substituted for an export, and absence is distinct from an unreadable file.
  select publication.* into v_publication
  from public.weekly_source_projection_publications publication
  join public.weekly_source_uploads upload on upload.id=publication.upload_id
  join public.weekly_source_cycles cycle on cycle.id=upload.source_cycle_id
  join public.weekly_source_format_profiles profile on profile.id=upload.source_format_profile_id
  where cycle.source_group_id=v_event.first_source_group_id
    and (cycle.scope_client_id is null or cycle.scope_client_id=v_event.client_id)
    and publication.state='CURRENT' and upload.state='CURRENT' and upload.purpose='ORDINARY'
    and publication.authority_scope_kind='CYCLE' and upload.report_scope_id is null
    and profile.profile_code in ('HEALTHROSTER_WEEKLY_FROM_TO_ACTUAL_V1',
      'HEALTHROSTER_WEEKLY_EXPLICIT_ACTUAL_V1','ROSTER_WEEKLY_SUMMARY_ACTUAL_V1')
    and upload.row_manifest_hash is not null and upload.coverage_state='COMPLETE'
    and upload.coverage_timezone='Europe/London'
    and v_event.work_date between upload.confirmed_coverage_start_local_date and upload.confirmed_coverage_end_local_date
    and (upload.file_metadata_json->>'client_id'=v_event.client_id::text
      or (nullif(upload.file_metadata_json->>'client_id','') is null and
        (select count(*) from public.weekly_source_group_clients gc
          where gc.source_group_id=cycle.source_group_id
            and cycle.finalisation_week_ending between gc.valid_from and coalesce(gc.valid_to,'infinity'::date))=1
        and exists(select 1 from public.weekly_source_group_clients gc
          where gc.source_group_id=cycle.source_group_id and gc.client_id=v_event.client_id
            and cycle.finalisation_week_ending between gc.valid_from and coalesce(gc.valid_to,'infinity'::date))))
  order by publication.published_at_utc desc,publication.created_at_utc desc,publication.id desc limit 1;
  if not found then raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_KEEP_AS_PAID_EXPORT_UNAVAILABLE' using errcode='55000'; end if;
  select * into strict v_upload from public.weekly_source_uploads where id=v_publication.upload_id;
  v_present:=exists(select 1 from public.weekly_source_upload_rows row
    join public.weekly_source_row_resolutions resolution on resolution.upload_row_id=row.id
      and resolution.generation=v_publication.projection_generation and resolution.mapping_state='RESOLVED'
    where row.upload_id=v_upload.id and resolution.work_event_id=v_event.id
      and resolution.candidate_id=v_event.candidate_id and resolution.client_id=v_event.client_id)
    or exists(select 1 from public.weekly_source_upload_rows row where row.upload_id=v_upload.id
      and row.external_source_key=v_event.profile_external_key
      and v_event.identity_kind='PROFILE_EXTERNAL_KEY');
  -- Actual current segments supply the pay-head movement identity. All real
  -- lineages/families are considered; zero is nullable, more than one refuses.
  select coalesce(array_agg(distinct scope.canonical_timesheet_id order by scope.canonical_timesheet_id),'{}'::uuid[])
    into v_roots from public.weekly_source_row_timesheet_lineages lineage
    cross join lateral public._pay_timesheet_rotation_scope(array[lineage.timesheet_id]) scope
    where lineage.work_event_id=v_event.id and lineage.candidate_id=v_event.candidate_id
      and lineage.client_id=v_event.client_id;
  foreach v_root in array v_roots loop
    select revision.id into v_revision from public.weekly_source_final_revisions revision
    join public.weekly_source_cycles cycle on cycle.id=revision.source_cycle_id
    where revision.state='CURRENT' and cycle.source_group_id=v_event.first_source_group_id
      and revision.authority_scope_kind='CYCLE'
      and (cycle.scope_client_id is null or cycle.scope_client_id=v_event.client_id)
    order by cycle.finalisation_week_ending desc,revision.finalised_at_utc desc,revision.revision_number desc,revision.id desc limit 1;
    if v_revision is not null then
      v_segments:=private.weekly_source_ordinary_projection_current_segments_v1(v_root,v_revision);
      for v_segment in select value from jsonb_array_elements(v_segments) loop
        if v_segment#>>'{weekly_source,work_event_id}'=v_event.id::text then
          v_movement:=(v_segment#>>'{weekly_source,movement_id}')::uuid;
          if v_movement is null or not exists(select 1 from public.weekly_source_billing_movements m
            join public.contracts c on c.id=m.contract_id
            where m.id=v_movement and m.work_event_id=v_event.id and m.candidate_id=v_event.candidate_id
              and m.actual_client_id=v_event.client_id and c.candidate_id=v_event.candidate_id and c.client_id=v_event.client_id
              and m.movement_role in ('POSITIVE','REPLACEMENT')
              and m.source_line_kind not in ('SELF_BILL_REPORT_LINE','INVOICE_VAT_ROUNDING','SOURCE_REBILL_LINE','SOURCE_INVOICE_CORRECTION')) then
            raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_KEEP_AS_PAID_HEAD_UNBOUND' using errcode='55000'; end if;
          if not v_movement=any(v_movements) then v_movements:=array_append(v_movements,v_movement); end if;
        end if;
      end loop;
    end if;
  end loop;
  if cardinality(v_movements)>1 then raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_KEEP_AS_PAID_HEAD_AMBIGUOUS' using errcode='55000'; end if;
  -- Full real credit-line census: actual CURRENT bindings/line IDs, negative
  -- Report lines bound to this event, and native validated unbound Office ADJ.
  select coalesce(array_agg(distinct line_id order by line_id),'{}'::uuid[]) into v_credits from (
    select binding.invoice_line_id line_id
    from public.weekly_source_invoice_line_bindings binding
    join public.weekly_source_billing_movements movement on movement.id=binding.billing_movement_id
    join public.invoice_lines line on line.id=binding.invoice_line_id and line.invoice_id=binding.invoice_id
    join public.invoices invoice on invoice.id=line.invoice_id and invoice.client_id=v_event.client_id
    join public.weekly_source_final_revisions revision on revision.id=movement.final_revision_id
    join public.weekly_source_cycles cycle on cycle.id=revision.source_cycle_id and cycle.source_group_id=v_event.first_source_group_id
    join public.weekly_source_upload_rows report_row on report_row.id=movement.self_bill_report_row_id
      and report_row.upload_id=revision.upload_id and report_row.row_finalisation_state='SOURCE_REPORT_LINE'
      and report_row.source_shift_charge_pence<0
    where binding.state='CURRENT' and movement.work_event_id=v_event.id
      and movement.source_line_kind='SELF_BILL_REPORT_LINE' and movement.source_profile_kind='SELF_BILL_REPORT'
      and line.total_charge_ex_vat<0 and (exists(select 1 from public.weekly_source_self_bill_report_line_bindings report_binding
        where report_binding.report_row_id=report_row.id and report_binding.work_event_id=v_event.id)
        or exists(select 1 from public.weekly_source_billing_movements prior
          join public.weekly_source_upload_rows prior_report_row on prior_report_row.id=prior.self_bill_report_row_id
          where prior.id=movement.prior_movement_id and prior.work_event_id=v_event.id
            and prior.source_line_kind='SELF_BILL_REPORT_LINE' and prior_report_row.external_source_key=report_row.external_source_key))
    union
    select line.id from public.invoice_lines line join public.invoices invoice on invoice.id=line.invoice_id
    where invoice.client_id=v_event.client_id and line.meta_json->>'credited_work_event_id'=v_event.id::text
      and invoice.header_snapshot_json#>>'{meta,source_group_id}'=v_event.first_source_group_id::text
      and private.weekly_source_invoice_adjustment_line_valid_v1(line.id,invoice.id)
  ) actual;
  return private.weekly_source_sha256_jsonb_v1('WEEKLY_SOURCE_KEPT_AS_PAID_FACTS_V1',
    jsonb_build_object('work_event_id',v_event.id,'reason',p_reason,'present_in_latest_export',v_present,
      'current_pay_head_movement_id',v_movements[1],'credit_invoice_line_ids',to_jsonb(v_credits)));
end;
$function$;

    and (cycle.scope_client_id is null or cycle.scope_client_id=v_event.client_id)
    and publication.state='CURRENT' and upload.state='CURRENT'
    and publication.source_cycle_id=cycle.id and publication.report_scope_id is null
    and cycle.current_projection_publication_id=publication.id
    and ((upload.purpose='ORDINARY' and upload.correction_session_id is null
      and publication.correction_session_id is null)
      or (upload.purpose='FINAL_SOURCE_CORRECTION' and exists(
          select 1 from public.weekly_final_source_correction_sessions applied
          join public.weekly_source_final_revisions final on final.id=applied.applied_final_revision_id
          where applied.id=upload.correction_session_id and publication.correction_session_id=applied.id
            and applied.source_cycle_id=cycle.id and applied.authority_scope_kind='CYCLE'
            and applied.report_scope_id is null and applied.state='APPLIED'
            and applied.prepared_final_revision_id=applied.applied_final_revision_id
            and applied.replacement_correction_upload_id=upload.id
            and applied.replacement_projection_publication_id=publication.id
            and applied.completed_at_utc is not null
            and final.source_cycle_id=cycle.id and final.authority_scope_kind='CYCLE'
            and final.report_scope_id is null and final.upload_id=upload.id
            and final.reason='CORRECT_FINAL_SOURCE' and final.state='CURRENT'
            and final.predecessor_revision_id=applied.expected_current_final_revision_id
            and cycle.current_final_revision_id=final.id
            and applied.result_json->>'status'='CORRECTED'
            and applied.result_json->>'correction_session_id'=applied.id::text
            and applied.result_hash=private.weekly_source_sha256_jsonb_v1(
              'WEEKLY_SOURCE_CORRECT_FINAL_RESULT_V1',applied.result_json)
            and applied.review_result_hash=private.weekly_source_sha256_jsonb_v1(
              'WEEKLY_SOURCE_CORRECT_FINAL_REVIEW_RESULT_V1',applied.review_result_json))))
    and publication.authority_scope_kind='CYCLE' and upload.report_scope_id is null
    and profile.profile_code in ('HEALTHROSTER_WEEKLY_FROM_TO_ACTUAL_V1',
      'HEALTHROSTER_WEEKLY_EXPLICIT_ACTUAL_V1','ROSTER_WEEKLY_SUMMARY_ACTUAL_V1')
    and upload.row_manifest_hash is not null and upload.coverage_state='COMPLETE' and upload.coverage_timezone='Europe/London'
    and v_event.work_date between upload.confirmed_coverage_start_local_date and upload.confirmed_coverage_end_local_date
    and (upload.file_metadata_json->>'client_id'=v_event.client_id::text or
      (nullif(upload.file_metadata_json->>'client_id','') is null and
        (select count(*) from public.weekly_source_group_clients gc where gc.source_group_id=cycle.source_group_id
          and cycle.finalisation_week_ending between gc.valid_from and coalesce(gc.valid_to,'infinity'::date))=1
        and exists(select 1 from public.weekly_source_group_clients gc where gc.source_group_id=cycle.source_group_id
          and gc.client_id=v_event.client_id and cycle.finalisation_week_ending between gc.valid_from and coalesce(gc.valid_to,'infinity'::date))))
  order by publication.published_at_utc desc,publication.created_at_utc desc,publication.id desc limit 1;
  if v_publication is null then raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_KEEP_AS_PAID_EXPORT_UNAVAILABLE' using errcode='55000'; end if;
 perform private.weekly_source_kept_as_paid_read_for_publication_v1(v_event.id,p_actor_user_id,v_publication);
end;
$function$;
